skill.name: citation-management
skill.description: Manage academic citations with bundled guides and Python scripts for Scholar and PubMed search, DOI, PMID, arXiv metadata extraction, citation validation, and BibTeX formatting.
skill.summary: Search, extract, validate, and format scholarly citations for research bibliographies.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The skill is a legitimate citation-management package, but it includes executable Python workflows that make outbound requests, read optional NCBI configuration, and write user-selected files. Most documentation, BibTeX examples, Markdown backticks, DOI values, and obfuscation detections are false positives, while the proxy mode, API-key handling, network calls, and file writes remain confirmed risks.

remediation.issue: Google Scholar free proxy mode can route research queries through unknown proxies and bypass rate limits.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the free proxy option, or require explicit user approval and user-supplied trusted proxy configuration before enabling it.

remediation.issue: Scripts send search terms, identifiers, optional email values, and optional API keys to external scholarly services.
remediation.suggestion: Add clear runtime prompts and documentation that disclose each external service before requests are made.

remediation.issue: Several scripts write to user-selected paths, and the formatter can overwrite the input file.
remediation.suggestion: Require overwrite confirmation, validate output paths, and default to creating new files instead of modifying originals.

remediation.issue: The skill allows Bash and documents package installation from PyPI.
remediation.suggestion: Narrow command guidance to the required scripts and require explicit confirmation before installing dependencies or running Bash commands.

content.value_statement: Academic bibliographies often collect incomplete metadata and duplicate records. This skill provides search, extraction, validation, and BibTeX cleanup workflows for research references.
actual_capabilities: Search PubMed through E-utilities and export results as JSON or BibTeX.
Search Google Scholar through the scholarly library when the dependency is installed.
Convert DOI, PMID, arXiv ID, or article URL metadata into BibTeX entries.
Validate BibTeX files for required fields, DOI resolution, duplicates, and format issues.
Format, sort, deduplicate, and clean BibTeX files.
Provide reference guides and a checklist for citation quality review.
limitations: Google Scholar search depends on the scholarly package and can be rate limited or blocked.
Some documented options are not implemented in the bundled scripts and need verification before use.
Metadata quality depends on external services such as CrossRef, PubMed, and arXiv.
Scripts can write or overwrite files selected by the user.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Thesis Bibliography
use_cases.description: Convert known DOIs and article URLs into clean BibTeX, then validate the final reference file.

use_cases.title: Build a Biomedical Search Set
use_cases.description: Search PubMed with MeSH terms, collect PMIDs, and export citation metadata for review teams.

use_cases.title: Clean Submission References
use_cases.description: Find duplicate entries, broken DOIs, missing fields, and inconsistent BibTeX formatting before submission.

prompt_templates.title: Convert One DOI
prompt_templates.prompt: Use citation-management to convert this DOI to a clean BibTeX entry: [DOI]. Verify the metadata source and show any missing fields.

prompt_templates.title: Validate a BibTeX File
prompt_templates.prompt: Use citation-management to validate references.bib. Report missing fields, duplicate entries, invalid DOI formats, and formatting problems. Do not overwrite files without asking.

prompt_templates.title: Build a PubMed Bibliography
prompt_templates.prompt: Use citation-management to search PubMed for [topic] from [start year] to [end year], export results, extract metadata, and produce a BibTeX file. Ask before using any API key.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Manuscript Library
prompt_templates.prompt: Use citation-management to combine these BibTeX files, remove duplicates, sort by year, verify DOIs, and generate a concise repair plan for unresolved entries: [files].

output_examples.input: Validate a 150-entry BibTeX file before journal submission.
output_examples.output: A concise validation report listing required field errors, duplicate candidates, unresolved DOIs, and recommended manual fixes.

output_examples.input: Convert a list of DOIs for a thesis chapter.
output_examples.output: A clean bibliography draft with normalized citation keys, protected scientific terms in titles, and notes for unresolved entries.

output_examples.input: Search PubMed for recent clinical trials on a topic.
output_examples.output: A ranked result summary with PMIDs, publication years, journals, and a suggested BibTeX export workflow.

best_practices: Confirm before running scripts that contact external databases or install packages.
Keep API keys in environment variables and avoid sharing logs that include credentials.
Review generated citations against publisher pages before final submission.
anti_patterns: Do not use the free proxy mode for sensitive or private research queries.
Do not overwrite original BibTeX files without a backup or explicit output path.
Do not assume extracted metadata is publication-ready without validation.

faq.question: Does this skill support PubMed searches?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a PubMed E-utilities script with query, date, publication type, JSON, and BibTeX export support.

faq.question: Does it require API keys?
faq.answer: Most workflows can run without keys. NCBI API keys and email values are optional but may improve PubMed rate limits.

faq.question: Can it search Google Scholar?
faq.answer: Yes, when the scholarly dependency is installed. Google Scholar may rate limit or block automated searches.

faq.question: Can it validate an existing BibTeX file?
faq.answer: Yes. The validation script checks required fields, DOI format and resolution, duplicate entries, and common formatting issues.

faq.question: Does it send data to external services?
faq.answer: Yes. Search terms, identifiers, optional email values, and optional API keys may be sent to public scholarly services.

faq.question: Can it replace manual citation review?
faq.answer: No. It automates lookup and checks, but users should verify important citations against publisher records.
